title: Trust the Right Teacher: Quality-Aware Self-Distillation for GUI Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2606.18101v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: GUI grounding requires vision-language models (VLMs) to identify small target elements in high-resolution screenshots and predict precise screen coordinates. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is a promising post-training approach for this coordinate-sensitive task because it provides dense token-level teacher signals beyond hard coordinate labels. However, naive OPSD is not well-suited to GUI grounding: since the teacher is evaluated on student-generated prefixes, its coordinate-token signals can become unreliable once a prefix deviates from the target coordinate. We propose quality-aware self-distillation for GUI grounding, centered on direct spatial correctness verification of teacher predictions. A soft gate checks whether the teacher's top coordinate-token prediction can still be completed into the ground-truth box under the student-generated prefix and down-weights the signal when this check fails. translated_title: 信任正确的教师：面向GUI定位的质量感知自蒸馏
translated_abstract: GUI定位要求视觉语言模型（VLM）在高分辨率截图中识别微小的目标元素并预测精确的屏幕坐标。在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）是这一坐标敏感任务的一种有前景的后训练方法，因为它能提供超越硬坐标标签的密集token级教师信号。然而，朴素的OPSD并不适合GUI定位：由于教师模型是在学生模型生成的前缀上进行评估的，一旦前缀偏离目标坐标，其坐标token信号就可能变得不可靠。我们提出了一种面向GUI定位的质量感知自蒸馏方法，其核心是对教师预测进行直接的空间正确性验证。一个软门控机制会检查教师模型的首要坐标token预测在学生生成的前缀下是否仍能被补全到真实边界框内，并在该检查失败时降低该信号的权重。教师概率缩放……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出面向GUI定位的质量感知自蒸馏方法，通过软门控对教师坐标预测进行空间正确性验证并动态降低不可靠教师信号的权重，从而提升坐标预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: Proposes quality-aware self-distillation for GUI grounding that uses a soft gate to verify the spatial correctness of teacher predictions and down-weights unreliable teacher signals, improving coordinate prediction accuracy.
